target_customer: Digital health companies, providers and payers that need patient medical records and health data through one API
problem: Patient records are scattered across health information exchanges, EHRs, labs and pharmacies, and each digital health company had to build and maintain these connections itself.
business_model: API and platform subscription with usage pricing, open source core, plus AI summarization and monitoring products
product_category: Healthcare data infrastructure and interoperability API

founders.name: Dima Goncharov
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built aerospace systems and highly available cloud database services.

founders.name: Colin Elsinga
founders.background_notes: YC page says software engineer and designer with experience building consumer health apps.

technical_complexity.rationale: Connecting to national health information exchanges, matching and deduplicating patient records, and standardizing clinical formats requires deep interoperability engineering and compliance work.

defensibility.rationale: Network connections, certifications and customer integrations are slow to replicate, though the core is open source and commoditized by national frameworks.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Fierce Healthcare later named Holon and Moxe Health as rivals; the company kept growing and raised a Series A in 2026.

market_need_then: Digital health companies repeatedly rebuilt record retrieval; the 2022 launch coincided with push toward national exchange networks. By 2026 the company reports Amazon One Medical, Color and Sollis Health as customers.

branding.brand_signature: Open source positioning in healthcare data
branding.community_and_virality: Open source GitHub project and a pulse2 founder profile; no merch or fan community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Recognized in health IT press for the open source angle, but no sources show brand driven growth.

pivots.from: Open source Health Devices API for wearables and mHealth data
pivots.to: Open source Medical API for clinical record retrieval from EHR networks
pivots.why: Not stated; company announced the Medical API launch in September 2023.

outcome_analysis: Metriport raised a 2.4 million dollar seed on post money SAFEs at a stated 20 million valuation in December 2022, shifted from a wearables API to clinical record retrieval in 2023, and by 2026 had a 29 person team, named healthcare customers and a 26 million Series A led by Matrix. The company is active and growing, with the open source posture and exchange network connections as its main assets.
notes: Seed valuation is the company's own statement via search snippet of its blog (the direct fetch of the blog URL returned 404). Series A confirmed by several outlets; one aggregator gives a September date, others late August. Cumulative 28.4M is aggregator reported and not used. Holon and Moxe Health were named by Fierce Healthcare in an undated article, so competitors as of founding are left empty. Branding search returned nothing on name origin.
